pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Variable geometry consisting of elongated, sub-polygonal dark regions on the neck and smaller, more fragmented shapes on the flank; edges exhibit soft pixel-to-pixel transitions with low angularity.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways forming a topological graph with high node density on the flank; pathway thickness is relatively thin compared to patch area with visible tapering at junctions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-grained, high-frequency sawtooth contour visible along the upper neck and shoulder ridge against the background pixels.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark-pigmented avian subject (oxpecker) perched on the mid-dorsal ridge of the neck.
